stage: Frozen comparison; locked before test forecasts
past_split: At first test origin: first 320 available supervised examples fit, next 96 choose alpha; refit these 416 examples; remaining past examples calibrate residual quantiles. No test-origin outcome used. Classical fits remain fixed across 16 origins.
screening: Top two available variables by maximum absolute training-prefix correlation over all four lags; first-origin known labels only; ranking fixed across test origins; never oracle identities.
features: All available raw covariate x lag columns, target-history lags 0..3, and (interaction arms only) every unordered pair of distinct covariates at all 4x4 lag combinations. No true-pair preselection.
primary_metric: Mean twice pinball loss over the checkpoint's 21 quantiles, then origins, then independent product tasks; no scale normalization needed for unit-signal bank
statistics: 10000 task-paired bootstrap draws; product primary; additive positive control separately; no origin/view pseudo-replication
joint_gain: min(task loss u, task loss v) - task loss uv; min is taken at task level, then averaged
null_penalty: task loss uvN8 - task loss uv
gate_joint: Frozen Chronos-2 product G_joint mean >0.01 and paired 95% CI lower >0
gate_nuisance: Frozen Chronos-2 product P_null8 mean >0.01 and paired 95% CI lower >0
interaction_floor: A practical all-candidate interaction arm recovers >=80% of the history-to-privileged-noise-oracle loss gap and beats frozen full-context Chronos-2 with paired CI upper<0: product toy alone does not justify TSFM training
training_gate: Run the proposed 2x2 only if joint and nuisance gates both pass and the interaction floor does not cheaply solve the toy. Otherwise archive the frozen stage without claiming a new training-method failure.
oracle: Diagnostic only: true useful pair, sign, lags and noise scale; not included as practical baseline
limits: Known synthetic product/additive families, 10 variables, lags0..3, 512 history. No nonlinear-generalization, real-series, other TSFM, or training claim. Clean u/v views are privileged input interventions; deployed uvN8 view contains no useful-variable markers.
